paragraphs: Rabbi Natan bar Tovi, (a student of Rabbi Yohanan).

[Berakhot 28a](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.28a.16-17) relates that when Rabbi Zeira tired from studying, he sat at Rabbi Natan bar Tovi’s doorway. Natan came out. Zeira asked: “Who stated a ruling in the study hall?” He answered: “Rabbi Yohanan says that the law does not follow Rabbi Yehudah.” Zeira learned it from him forty times. Natan asked Zeira: “Is this your only teaching, or is it new to you?” etc.[^1]
[Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:1](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Berakhot.4.1.16), 26b, likewise has him disputing Rabbi Zeira in Rabbi Yohanan’s name about the afternoon prayer.[^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli has Zeira learn the ruling from Natan and repeat it forty times. [Heilprin’s retelling](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2737&lang=en) gives the learning in the opposite direction.
The linked Yerushalmi has Natan speak in Rabbi Yochanan’s name about which afternoon prayer comes first. Hyman gives the additional folio locator 26b.
